item.title: Humans "close to being outsmarted" by superintelligence, AI expert says
item.description: Rapid developments in AI are prompting concerns about "superintelligence." Here's why some experts are worried.

item.title: Here are the biggest announcements from today's Apple event
item.description: Apple introduced the iPhone 18 at its annual tech showcase and unveiled its first foldable phone.

item.title: Feds to buy up to $6 billion in Treasury bonds. Here's why.
item.description: Wall Street analysts are skeptical that the Treasury Department's bond purchases can curb yields and lower U.S. borrowing costs.

item.title: Federal judge backs Missouri's new House map after Supreme Court rebuffs case
item.description: A federal judge ruled that Missouri should use a new congressional map that favors Republicans for now, hours after the U.S. Supreme Court left in place a ruling from the state's highest court directing Missouri to use an older map.

item.title: Apple unveils first foldable iPhone
item.description: Apple on Wednesday accomplished two firsts: It unveiled its first foldable iPhone at its first launch event fronted by new CEO John Ternus. "Apple in China" author Patrick McGee joins CBS News with more.

item.title: Trump's trip delayed after emergency slide deploys on new Air Force One
item.description: President Trump's departure to Texas was delayed after an emergency slide on the new Air Force One deployed on the tarmac before he boarded.

item.title: Trump says Iran war will end "immediately after" midterm elections
item.description: Ahead of his appearance at the Republican midterm convention in Texas on Wednesday, President Trump told reporters that he thinks the war with Iran will end "immediately after" the midterm elections. CBS News chief White House correspondent Nancy Cordes has more.

item.title: Anthropic researcher quits, warns AI "could kill all of us by the end of the decade"
item.description: A former Anthropic researcher has quit his job over concerns about the potential threat artificial intelligence poses to humanity. CBS News senior business and technology correspondent Jo Ling Kent reports. Then, CNET AI reporter Katelyn Chedraoui joins to discuss.

item.title: Sen. Rick Scott touts Trump's accomplishments at GOP midterm convention
item.description: The Republican National Committee Midterm Convention kicked off in Dallas on Wednesday. Republican Sen. Rick Scott of Florida joins CBS News from the floor to discuss what makes this year's midterms different.

item.title: What to make of alarming AI warnings from researchers tied to Anthropic
item.description: A lead researcher at Anthropic said Wednesday he believes there's a more than 10% chance AI "could kill all humans" within the next decade. The comments came in response to a social media post from another Anthropic researcher who said he was resigning while claiming OpenAI and Anthropic aren't acting responsibly. Gerrit De Vynck, AI reporter for the Washington Post, joins CBS News to discuss.

item.title: Afghanistan War veterans reunite, talk about return to civilian life | 60 Minutes Archive
item.description: Members of a U.S. Marines unit which suffered high casualties in the Afghanistan War share the struggles they faced when returning to civilian life, and the PTSD they dealt with years after war.

item.title: CBS News poll finds that 25 years after 9/11 most see changed country
item.description: A big majority say it's very important that Americans remember the 9/11 attacks.

item.title: Talarico says Ken Paxton is "lying to the people of Texas" with AI ad that puts "words in my mouth"
item.description: Democrat James Talarico told CBS News' Ed O'Keefe he won't use AI in political advertising in the race for the Texas U.S. Senate seat, adding, "every ad that we put out is made by human beings."

item.title: Full interview: James Talarico on affordability, Paxton's AI ads and more
item.description: CBS News senior White House and political correspondent Ed O'Keefe spoke with Texas Democrat James Talarico on Wednesday about his agenda if he's elected to the Senate, the state of his race against Texas Republican Attorney General Ken Paxton and more. Watch the full interview.

item.title: Oil tops $100 per barrel as U.S. and Iran launch new attacks
item.description: The price of crude oil hit a 15-week high after the U.S. said it blew up five more Iranian oil tankers, triggering retaliation from Tehran.

item.title: Oil hits $101 per barrel as U.S. and Iran trade new strikes
item.description: The international benchmark for oil, Brent crude, topped $100 per barrel on Wednesday as new attacks flared up between the U.S. and Iran. CBS News' Ramy Inocencio reports and Matt Smith, director of commodity research at Kpler, joins with analysis.

item.title: Afghan girls who study in secret want you to read their "letters to the world"
item.description: 21 Afghan girls, bravely defying the Taliban by continuing to study, handed CBS News letters containing their stifled, often humble dreams "for an ordinary life."

item.title: Don Jr.'s VC firm rejects Rep. Raskin's accusations of "insider political influence"
item.description: Rep. Jamie Raskin launched an investigation last month into the president's son's investment firm and its "almost clairvoyant" business moves.

item.title: Donald Trump Jr.'s venture capital firm rejects accusations of "insider political influence"
item.description: Donald Trump Jr.'s venture capital firm pushed back Tuesday against claims made by Rep. Jamie Raskin about potential "insider political influence." Reed Cowan has the details.

item.title: The U.S. just had its hottest summer on record, NOAA says
item.description: Average temperatures across the U.S. soared to record heights between June and August in 2026, a new report found.

item.title: Trump says he had "great conversation" with Putin amid renewed peace push
item.description: "He is wanting to make a deal. And if Zelenskyy is wanting to make a deal, that would be very nice," President Trump said.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy Mistrial: Reddington Weighs In | Case by Case | "48 Hours" Podcast
item.description: In the wake of the mistrial in the Lindsay Clancy murder case, CBS News correspondent Shanelle Kaul and WBZ-TV reporter and anchor Kristina Rex share new reporting from inside the courtroom, exclusive juror insights, and behind-the-scenes details of the dramatic final courtroom moments. Plus, we learn what's next as the Plymouth County District Attorney's Office weighs its options.

item.title: How much interest will a $25,000 6-month CD earn at today's rates?
item.description: Moving $25,000 into a 6-month CD could prove to be lucrative. Here's how much interest savers can expect to earn.

item.title: Judge orders bond increase for Barry Morphew after arrest
item.description: A Colorado judge ordered an increase in bond for murder suspect Barry Morphew on Tuesday from $3 million to $10 million cash only.

item.title: Zelenskyy's plane almost hit by drone, Norway's prime minister says
item.description: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy joined a host of other foreign dignitaries in Oslo for the funeral of Norway's King Harald V.

item.title: Some fliers may be able to bring water through TSA checkpoints soon, officials say
item.description: The TSA is not prepared to eliminate all liquid restrictions, and the existing rule limiting other carry-on liquids to 3.4 ounces remains in effect.

item.description: A top Anthropic researcher says there's more than a 10% chance AI "could kill all humans," after a colleague resigned over similar concerns.

item.title: Dolly Parton's sister shares why the country music star kept her cancer battle private
item.description: Dolly Parton died in Nashville on Aug. 25 at the age of 80 — a shock to fans around the world​ who weren't aware of her illness.

item.title: Stefany Shaheen, Anthony DiLorenzo win New Hampshire primaries, CBS News projects
item.description: Stefany Shaheen and Anthony DiLorenzo Won their respective primaries to replace Democratic Rep. Chris Pappas in New Hampshire's 1st Congressional District, CBS News projects.
